$ rm testdata/hypercase.json  # the registry is lost
$ go test  # echo-shout
    testdata/hypercase.json is missing. It records what the package registers, for tools and for the root-package check.
        Run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to write it.
    no registry records a root-package check for the module-root corpus, so nothing reports what no column there owns.
        Register hypercase.RootPackage() in one package over it, then run FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... to record it in the package's registry.
    testdata/script/ holds archives, and no registry declares the directory: no corpus type has it as its Dir, and no suite names it as its Corpus.
        Declare a decl.Type with that Dir, or move or delete the archives.
--- FAIL: TestCorpus
    --- PASS: TestCorpus/script
        --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/echo
            --- PASS: TestCorpus/script/twice/shout
FAIL
[exit 1]
